prompts: An old man with short grey hair and a lined, clean-shaven face, in a long rust-brown wool coat with a patched elbow and brown leather gloves sits on the end of a wooden bench beside a log fire in a stone cottage, leaning toward the fire. Beside him stands a small barefoot boy with long tousled light-brown hair, in a patched grey tunic and patched brown trousers. The boy steps to the bench and sits down beside the man, folding his hands in his lap. The man straightens up and turns his head to look at the boy. The bench creaks as the boy sits. The camera is locked off and does not move. They are the only two people in the room, the man on the left near the fire and the boy on the right; neither one crosses in front of the other. Audio: the steady crackle and pop of the log fire, no music, no speech.
